title: THE FRONTIER WEEK · The stump
venue: the Newport paper · a western week the editor cut · Box 3
logline: Saturday: the stranger at the stump on the ridge at last, the crow leaving, the stake pulled and laid down, the dog sitting, and the stranger taking the card from his hatband and setting it face down on the stump and walking away. The last panel is the stump with the card on it, and no ridge, because the panel is the ridge. His name was the town's.
